answer_overlay_surface_label: Example answer-overlay posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded overlay-continuity surface for official voter-information routes that place controlling details or actions inside a dialog, drawer, bottom sheet, or similar answer-bearing overlay.

answer_overlay_routes.item_identity_note: The sheet heading names the selected early-voting site and its jurisdiction clearly enough to distinguish it from neighboring sites.
answer_overlay_routes.stable_detail_route_note: The sheet includes a share-safe 'Open full details page' route for the same site.
answer_overlay_routes.close_and_return_note: Closing the sheet returns the voter to the same selected site in the list without resetting the current county scope or visible position.

overlay_trigger_posture_note: Answer-bearing overlays open only after explicit voter action; focus movement, hover, or page load do not silently open them.
overlay_type_note: The route uses a mobile bottom sheet and a desktop side drawer for the same item-level detail surface.
overlay_context_identity_note: The overlay heading, scope line, and close control identify clearly which office, site, or notice is being shown.
stable_detail_route_note: When the overlay contains controlling operational details, a stable non-overlay detail route remains available for revisit, sharing, and citation.
deep_link_and_share_note: The route provides a share-safe deep link or equivalent stable route so the voter does not need to reconstruct the overlay path manually.
close_and_return_note: Closing the overlay returns the voter to the same parent route context and same controlling item rather than jumping to the top of the page or resetting the current view.
focus_and_keyboard_note: Opening the overlay moves focus into the overlay, keyboard traversal remains bounded while it is open, and close controls remain reachable and clearly labeled.
background_inertness_note: When the overlay is modal, the background route does not remain ambiguously interactive.
compact_mobile_note: Small-screen and zoomed layouts keep the selected item, close posture, and route-return meaning legible even when the overlay becomes full-screen.
same_item_refindability_note: After closing the overlay, the voter can re-find the same controlling item without repeating the whole search or filter path.
help_or_overview_escape_note: The route preserves an ordinary way back to the overview/list/help lane if the overlay is inconvenient or incomplete.
